method: Exactly two ordinary attempts at http://127.0.0.1:5173/ using the existing visible-playtest driver and installed Chrome fallback. Read visible Mission Brief and How to Play before deployment. No source, tests, old reviews, hidden state, or implementation inspection.
ratingStatus: Provisional judgment of the game experienced across two failed missions, not a completion or perfection certification.

strengths.observation: The storm yard has a coherent cyan/amber visual identity, reflective wet ground, clear large station signs, and a confident title/end screen hierarchy.

ADS and firing gave an immediately understandable first fight: the centered induction guard could be eliminated, with ammo consumption and neutralized feedback visible. I later corrected aim and killed a smaller sentinel while strafing.
Core recovery has clear hold-E prompts, named people, filled objective boxes, and useful supplies restoration. I recovered all three distinct archive locations across the two runs.
Soul Shift produced visible PHASE EVADE feedback on my second run, and its cooldown stayed legible.

issues.observation: Waypoints led toward destinations through intervening structures. I repeatedly pressed into service cover and the west archive wall while trying to follow the nearest core; the south-intake/east-service hint did not let me resolve the route quickly under fire. This contributed strongly to both deaths. I cannot distinguish my navigation errors from any collision problem and do not claim a collision bug.

Small distant orange emitters were much less readable as enemies than the introductory guard. Multiple broad threat cues accumulated while I was facing a wall or moving toward an objective, but they did not give me a quick usable picture of the attackers. Health collapsed during movement between objectives.

World geometry and enemies look simple and repetitive compared with the polished graphic design. The mission I experienced offered a promising combat/recovery loop but limited visual variety; the AAA readiness rating reflects that gap and incomplete full-mission coverage.

coverageGapsAndLimits: Neither attempt reached three simultaneous memories, extraction upload, upload decay, or victory. Full mission ending and extraction balance remain unassessed.

Capture-driven synthetic keyboard/mouse controls and Escape pauses substantially limit judgments of continuous aim feel, reaction difficulty, pacing, and enjoyment. My route and aim mistakes remain in the evidence.
Used mouse look, ADS/fire, reload, sprint, movement, hold-E recovery, and Soul Shift. No successful close-range charge-break was established; one phase evade was displayed.
No audio enjoyment or hardware/FPS claims. Software-WebGL fallback flags do not certify actual renderer or performance.
No third attempt, no rescore, and no prior evidence consulted.

closure.verification: After close, ps -p 60135,60136 -o pid=,command= returned no output and exit 1, confirming both exact owned PIDs absent.
